about_pullquote: I got into heating because I hated seeing families shivering because of cowboys.
about_para_1: Danni Lay has been fixing and installing heating systems across Sunderland for over 15 years. Started as an apprentice, gained full Gas Safe registration, and has built a reputation for turning up on time, fixing problems properly, and charging fair prices. The business grew word-of-mouth because customers kept calling back and recommending mates.
about_para_2: What sets Danni Lay apart is the same-day callout promise on emergencies and the willingness to explain what's gone wrong without the jargon. Repeat customers make up a large part of the work — annual services, system upgrades, and landlord inspections from people who trust the service and the price.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Danni Lay

reviews.text: Had no heating on a Monday night in January. Called Danni and he was here by 8am the next morning. Turned out to be the pump. Fixed it same day for a fair price. Brilliant service, can't fault him.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Used Danni for our annual boiler service and he also spotted a small leak on the radiator before it became a problem. Very thorough, knows his stuff, and didn't try to sell us anything we didn't need.
reviews.author: Sandra L.

reviews.text: Landlord certificate needed for our rental property. Danni came, did the full safety check, explained everything, and sent the paperwork quickly. Will use him again next year.
reviews.author: Chris M.
